debug_log.description: Path to the file for debug logging. If empty or default, uses /tmp/tuigreet.log.

session_cmd.description: Command to run on successful authentication (e.g., 'weston', 'sway').

wayland_sessions_dir.description: Colon-separated list of directories containing Wayland session desktop files.

wayland_session_wrapper.description: Wrapper command for non-X11 sessions. Empty string uses default behavior.

x11_sessions_dir.description: Colon-separated list of directories containing X11 session desktop files.

no_x11_session_wrapper.description: If true, do not wrap commands for X11 sessions.

prompt_width.description: Number of columns the main prompt area should take.

show_issue.description: Print the content of /etc/issue at the top of the prompt area.

greeting_text.description: Custom greeting text. Mutually exclusive with show_issue if both are set (template logic prefers one).

show_time.description: Print the current date and time at the top of the screen.

time_format.description: strftime-compliant format string for the time.

enable_user_menu.description: Allow selecting a user from a graphical menu.

user_menu_min_uid.description: Minimum UID of users to display in the selection menu.

user_menu_max_uid.description: Maximum UID of users to display in the selection menu.

remember_username.description: Remember the username of the last successfully opened session.

remember_user_session.description: Remember the last opened session per user.

theme_spec.description: Theme specification string for UI colors.

show_asterisks.description: Add visual feedback (asterisks) when typing secrets.

window_padding.description: Spacing between the edge of the screen and the drawing area in columns.

container_padding.description: Spacing between the border of the prompt area and its contents in columns.

prompt_padding.description: Spacing between form fields in rows.

greet_align.description: Alignment of the greeting text: left, center, or right.

power_shutdown_cmd.description: Command to run when instructed to shut down.

power_reboot_cmd.description: Command to run when instructed to reboot.

power_no_setsid.description: Do not prefix power commands with setsid.
